messages:
Anika (Eng): Quick heads up — I need to relocate to my partner's place in Boise from 2026-05-03 for ~45 days to help with caregiving. Two quick things: 1) Is my WFH stipend prorated for a short-term address change? 2) Any payroll/tax nexus implications I should worry about? Also would Facilities ship my standing desk to the temporary address?
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks for the notice, Anika. Short answers: we can prorate the monthly WFH stipend by days away; domestic temporary moves under 90 days are typically OK and treated as temporary for payroll, but we log them. Please fill the short relocation form so we can record dates and shipping address: https://redwood.internal/relocate-form (no PII in Slack pls).
Ravi (Payroll): Re: tax nexus — company-level nexus is a separate threshold (usually >90 days across multiple people/activities), so a single 45-day temporary stay is unlikely to change company tax registration. For you personally, if you spend >30 consecutive days in another US state we may need to change your state tax withholding to ID for that pay period. We'll mark this as temporary withholding change and revert after you return.
Grace (Benefits): Health insurance stays active while you're on a temporary domestic move. If you have an HSA or flexible spending elections, check with benefits for provider network limits in Boise. If you're using dependent care benefits, confirm provider eligibility. I can loop in total-rewards if you want help.
Anika (Eng): Thanks — I'll complete the relocate form now. Shipping address: 412 W Desert Ave, Apt 2, Boise, ID 83702. Do we need photos for the desk delivery or any onsite sign-off?
Jordan (People Ops): No photos needed for standard furniture moves. Facilities will coordinate a delivery window and signature. I submitted the form for you and tagged facilities. Expect an email from Facilities within 48 hours with ETA. :thumbsup:
facilities-bot: New desk move request created (#F-9742). Assigned: Mateo. Delivery ETA pending. Please keep packing instructions in the form.
Ravi (Payroll): One small ask — when you fill the form, pick the "temporary state withholding" checkbox so we can auto-generate the payroll adjustment. Payroll will run a one-off state withholding change for the pay periods covering your stay and then revert on the return date.
payroll-bot: Automated note: submit payroll adjustment here -> https://payroll.internal/adjustments?req=F-9742. Sample address label to copy:
```
ANIKA S.
412 W DESERT AVE APT 2
BOISE, ID 83702
```
Anika (Eng): Got it, done — form submitted and checkbox checked. Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone.
Jordan (People Ops): All set. We'll log this under temporary-remote and flag payroll/benefits. If anything changes (dates, address, or if it becomes >90 days) please ping us immediately. Safe travels and hope caregiving goes smoothly. :heart:
Anika (Eng): Thanks y'all — I'll keep you posted.
